data.source:
import re

def solve(data):
    import re
    pattern = data["pattern"]
    text = data["text"]
    
    # Escape any non-escaped metacharacters in the pattern
    escaped_pattern = re.escape(pattern)
    
    # Use regular expression to match the escaped pattern with the text
    if re.fullmatch(escaped_pattern, text):
        return True
    else:
        return False
